heard: In 1915, pack ice crushed the expedition ship Endurance. 28 men were stranded on the drifting Antarctic ice. Carpenter Harry McNish sealed a 22-foot lifeboat with seal blood. Shackleton relied entirely on Worsley's navigation. They faced 800 miles of the world's deadliest ocean. Worsley found land using only four fleeting sun sightings. Every single man survived because the ice crushed the ship Endurance.
